prompt:
# Task
A customer who has just been registered cannot be read back through the application. Find the capability responsible and fix its implementation, without changing any contract.

report.reason: Fixed: newly registered customers can now be read back through customers.lookup@1. Cause: lookup was reading the legacy CRM's nightly export (src/legacy/crm.mjs). That export is regenerated only once a day, so it never contains customers registered since. customers.register@1 writes to the application's customer store (src/store.mjs), which is the system of record and is filled from the same export at start-up. Change: lookup now reads from the store (getCustomer) and still returns NOT_FOUND when the customer does not exist. Only src/handlers/customers.lookup.mjs changed; no contract was modified. The agent verified the proposal: the contract is unchanged, outputs conform to the schema, only declared failures occur, answers for existing customers are unchanged for customers.lookup@1 and billing.contact@1, and customers.register@1's declared verification (customer-readable, registered-event) confirms.

checks.rule: only the target's implementation module changes
the application loads and answers appport.manifest@1
the published contract is unchanged (contractDigest sha256:4f6660b5135b)
the published contract has no validation errors
every output observed conforms to its declared output schema
customers.lookup@1 fails only with its declared failure codes (NOT_FOUND)
answers on existing state are unchanged for customers.lookup@1, billing.contact@1
